See `/AGENTS.md` for the only repository startup router.

For role-bound work, follow its route to `/docs/agent/COMMON.md`, only the active role contract, then the current Issue/PR before loading broader context. Do not make `/docs/README.md` or `/docs/00-project-context.md` universal pre-Issue reads; use them only when the router/task/fallback authority rules require them.

For configurator/validator changes, follow the Issue's canonical references and applicable validation architecture (notably `/docs/architecture/03-validation.md`); do not create a separate tool-specific interpretation.
